name: 2023 World Championships Deck: Lost Box Kyogre

releases.name: 2023 World Championships Deck: Lost Box Kyogre

description.text:
The deck that won the Junior Division of the 2023 World Championships, the first Junior Division title for Taiwan. It depends on getting cards into the Lost Zone, which Comfey's Flower Selecting Ability and Colress's Experiment fill fast: with four there Cramorant attacks for no Energy, with seven Mirage Gate attaches Energy from the deck, and with ten Sableye's Lost Mine places twelve damage counters on the opponent's Pokémon. When the cards fall right, Kyogre's Aqua Storm, which discards the top five cards of the deck and does 50 damage to two Benched Pokémon for each Energy among them, can win the game. The 2023 World Championships were held at Pacifico Yokohama in Yokohama from 11 to 13 August 2023, the first in Japan and in Asia; 348 players from 36 nations played the card game there.

Pokémon sold it as one of four 2023 World Championships decks: a 60-card copy of the deck with a booklet, a pin, a coin, a deck box, a playmat, a poster and a code card for Pokémon Trading Card Game Live. Its cards have a limited-edition back, a silver border and the player's signature on the picture, and are not legal in tournaments.
